guide: QuadraticExplorer(a, b, c) — y = ax² + bx + c with sliders for a, b, c (−10..10); the plot, roots, vertex, discriminant and the quadratic formula with numbers substituted recompute live in the browser. a must not be 0. Use it for any 'show me / explore this quadratic' question instead of a VegaChart. Sends no events. Example: card = QuadraticExplorer(1, -2, -3)

QuadraticExplorer.description: An interactive quadratic y = ax² + bx + c with live plot, roots and vertex.
